questions.question: 🦅 Sami receives a patient with a fractured tooth. He says: 'Ceramic crown, it's the best!' 🐆 Mina asks him: 'And the material?' What is a ceramic crown?
options: A fixed prosthesis in pure ceramic, without metal, highly aesthetic
A metal crown covered with resin
A simple composite bonded to the tooth
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Pure ceramic offers exceptional aesthetics and perfect biocompatibility.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you know aesthetic materials well!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, examining a bridge, says: 'The abutments are healthy.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'We can do it on only 2 teeth.' What is a bridge?
options: A fixed prosthesis replacing one or more missing teeth, supported by abutments
A crown on a single tooth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A bridge is a fixed prosthesis that replaces one or more teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer short bridges, faster to make!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a removable prosthesis, says: 'That's for old people!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'Not at all!' What is a removable partial denture?
options: A prosthesis that the patient can remove and replace, replacing a few missing teeth
A crown on a natural tooth
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Removable partial dentures are indicated to replace several teeth with a limited budget.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're more open-minded than I thought!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a digital impression, says: 'It's precise and fast.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'Conventional impression is more reliable!' What is a digital impression?
options: An impression taken with an intraoral scanner, without traditional material
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Digital impression is precise, comfortable, and fast.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer alginate, but I admit the scanner is more comfortable for the patient.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a metal-ceramic crown, says: 'That's outdated!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'Not so fast!' What are the advantages of metal-ceramic?
options: Strength, good longevity, acceptable aesthetics, and affordable price
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Metal-ceramic remains a standard for its strength and durability.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're being reasonable today!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, examining a complete denture, says: 'Occlusion is paramount.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'Aesthetics first!' What is a complete denture?
options: A removable prosthesis replacing all teeth in an arch
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A complete denture replaces all teeth and occlusion is essential for stability.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, we'll work on occlusion, but we'll also make it aesthetic!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a post and core, says: 'That's useless!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'It's essential!' What is a post and core?
options: A core build-up for anchoring a crown on a root-treated tooth
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The post and core reinforces the root-treated tooth before crown placement.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're making progress!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a ceramic veneer, says: 'It's very aesthetic.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'It's fragile!' What is a dental veneer?
options: A thin ceramic shell bonded to the outer surface of the tooth for aesthetics
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Veneers offer remarkable aesthetics with minimal preparation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer crowns, more solid, but I admit veneers are more aesthetic.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a bonded bridge, says: 'That's a poor person's prosthesis!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'It's a validated technique!' What is a bonded (Maryland) bridge?
options: A bridge fixed by metal or ceramic wings on the adjacent teeth
A conventional bridge with crowns on abutments
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The bonded bridge is a conservative option to replace a tooth without preparing the abutments.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're really open-minded!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, examining an implant-supported prosthesis, says: 'Osseointegration is crucial.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'The prosthesis first!' What is osseointegration?
options: The direct bond between the titanium implant and the alveolar bone
The fixation of the crown on the implant
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Osseointegration is the key to implant success.' 🦅 Sami: 'I must admit Mina is right on this point.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a temporary crown, says: 'That's useless!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'It's essential!' What is the role of a temporary crown?
options: Protect the tooth, maintain space, and aesthetics while waiting for the definitive prosthesis
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The temporary crown is essential for protection and function.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you've finally understood the importance of the temporary!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a composite resin, says: 'It's perfect for small restorations.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'Ceramic is always better!' What is a composite resin?
options: An aesthetic restorative material, bonded directly to the tooth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Composite is versatile and allows direct aesthetic restorations.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer ceramic, but composite has its advantages.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a 3-unit bridge, says: 'That's too long to make.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'You have to take your time!' How many teeth can a bridge replace?
options: A bridge can replace 1 to 3 teeth depending on the clinical situation
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The length of the bridge depends on the quality of the abutments and the occlusion.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you know the limits of the bridge!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, examining a patient with a removable prosthesis, says: 'The clasps must be discreet.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'The essential thing is that it stays!' What is a prosthesis clasp?
options: A metal or flexible element that holds the removable prosthesis on the teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Clasps ensure the retention of the removable prosthesis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer rigid clasps, but I admit flexible ones are more aesthetic.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing an alginate impression, says: 'That's outdated!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'It's still used!' What is alginate?
options: A hydrocolloid impression material, used for study models
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Alginate is fast and economical for preliminary impressions.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're pragmatic!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a completely edentulous patient, says: 'Conventional complete denture.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'No, implants!' What guides the choice?
options: Bone condition, budget, and patient expectations
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The choice depends on multiple clinical and financial factors.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, we'll do a classic complete denture for this patient.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a prosthetic laboratory, says: 'They do all the work!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'The clinician is essential!' What is the clinician's role in prosthetics?
options: Preparation, impression, color selection, and try-in
No role, the laboratory does everything
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The clinician is responsible for the entire prosthetic process.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a zirconia crown, says: 'It's very aesthetic and strong.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'It's too expensive!' What is zirconia?
options: A high-strength ceramic material, without metal, highly aesthetic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Zirconia combines strength and aesthetics, without the risk of metal allergy.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer metal-ceramic for value for money, but I admit zirconia is aesthetically superior.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a prosthesis on 4 implants, says: 'That's too complicated!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'It's a validated technique!' What is an implant-supported prosthesis?
options: A prosthesis fixed on dental implants, offering optimal stability
A crown on a natural tooth
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Implant-supported prostheses offer unmatched stability and comfort.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're really up to date!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, examining a resin prosthesis, says: 'It's light and inexpensive.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'It's fragile!' What are the advantages of resin?
options: Lightness, low cost, ease of repair
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Resin is ideal for temporary prostheses or those with a limited budget.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer ceramic, but I understand the interest of resin.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a bonded bridge, says: 'It doesn't last!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'With good technique, it does!' What is the key to success for a bonded bridge?
options: Only the strength of the adhesive
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The success of the bonded bridge relies on adhesion and occlusion.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're an expert in bonded bridges!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a temporary crown, says: 'It must be kept for 15 days.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'We can put the definitive one right away!' Why is the temporary necessary?
options: To allow tissues to heal and evaluate function and aesthetics
Because the definitive crown is not ready
To get the patient used to it
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The temporary is an essential phase to validate the prosthetic project.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, we'll make a quality temporary then!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a removable prosthesis with a palatal plate, says: 'It's uncomfortable!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'It's necessary!' What is the role of the palatal plate?
options: Ensure retention and stability of the maxillary prosthesis
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The palatal plate is essential for the stability of the maxillary prosthesis.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you know removable prostheses well!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, examining an inlay, says: 'It's an indirect restoration.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'I prefer direct composite.' What is an inlay?
options: A laboratory-made restoration, cemented into the tooth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The inlay is an indirect ceramic or composite restoration, more resistant.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer direct for speed, but the inlay is more durable.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a patient with a prosthesis that moves, says: 'It's the lab's fault!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'It might be the occlusion!' What is the most frequent cause of prosthetic instability?
options: An occlusion, retention, or adaptation defect
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Instability is often multifactorial: occlusion, retention, adaptation.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're really a pro!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami and 🐆 Mina discuss the future of prosthetics. Sami says: '3D printers will change everything!' Mina replies: 'Clinical expertise remains key.' What is the future of prosthetics?
options: Technology helps but does not replace the clinician and the laboratory
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Technology is a valuable tool, but clinical expertise is irreplaceable.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree, we keep our jobs!'
